name: wani_cru_pose
desc: Same monster, same size, same head size and same body proportions, still facing left in three-quarter view. Now standing upright and tall in a crucifixion pose: both thick muscular arms stretched straight out horizontally to the left and right like a cross, open palms. Broad chest pushed forward and fully visible. Mouth closed in a smug grin showing its teeth, jaws not open. Lower body is a tall thick column of goo with no legs, melting into a puddle at the bottom.
